title.narrative: Entrepreneurship development in Creative Industries (CIs) to support the productive sector impacting on community-based tourism for job creation and poverty reduction (Phase 2)

description.narrative: Following the implementation of a UNIDO assisted and Austrian funded pilot project to promote culture-based creative industries (CI), 2009-August 2011, the RGoB through the MoLHR has proposed a second phase focusing on #creative entrepreneurship development for the CI sector to support community-based tourism. development, for job creation and poverty reduction.
